test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The ruins of this building do tell us the story of a** __defunct__** organisation.
solution: The correct answer is **"obsolete."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Defunct"** means no longer existing or in use. (जो न अस्तित्व में हो और न प्रयोग में; अप्रचलित) • **Example**: *I think this TV is **defunct**__.* • Synonym of **"defunct"** is **"obsolete."** • **"Obsolete"** means no longer in use or outdated. (प्रयोग की दृष्टि से पुरानी पड़ चुकी (क्‍योंकि उसका स्‍थान नई वस्‍तु ने ले लिया है); प्रयोगबाह्य, अब अप्रचलित, अव्‍यवहृत) __ • **Example**: *Typewriters have been rendered **obsolete**__ by computers.* • The sentence implies that the organization is no longer functional and the building is in ruins. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (ancient)** means belonging to the very distant past. (प्राचीन, पुरातन, हज़ारों वर्ष पुराना) • **Option 3 (contemporary)** means belonging to the present time. (समकालीन, समकालिक) • **Option 4 (prominent)** means important or famous. (महत्वपूर्ण या प्रसिद्घ) 35:T716, The correct answer is** "finish the marathon in record time."**
